post:
      description: Creates a new dashboard and returns its ID, full state, and metadata.
      operationId: post-dashboards
      parameters:
        - description: A required header to protect against CSRF attacks
          in: header
          name: kbn-xsrf
          required: true
          schema:
            example: 'true'
            type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Kibana_HTTP_APIs_kbn-dashboard-data'
      responses:
        '201':
          content:
            application/json:
              examples:
                createDashboardResponse:
                  description: |
                    Response to creating a dashboard. Returns the generated ID, the full dashboard state in `data`, and metadata. Default option values are always returned even when not explicitly set in the request. Panel `id` values are generated automatically.
                  summary: Create dashboard response
                  value:
                    data:
                      access_control:
                        access_mode: write_restricted
                      options:
                        auto_apply_filters: true
                        hide_panel_borders: false
                        hide_panel_titles: false
                        sync_colors: false
                        sync_cursor: true
                        sync_tooltips: false
                        use_margins: true
                      panels:
                        - config:
                            content: '## Web logs overview'
                          grid:
                            h: 15
                            w: 24
                            x: 0
                            'y': 0
                          id: a1b2c3d4-0001-4000-8000-000000000001
                          type: markdown
                        - config:
                            data_source:
                              index_pattern: kibana_sample_data_logs
                              time_field: timestamp
                              type: data_view_spec
                            ignore_global_filters: false
                            metrics:
                              - empty_as_null: false
                                operation: count
                                type: primary
                            sampling: 1
                            styling:
                              primary:
                                labels:
                                  alignment: left
                                position: bottom
                                value:
                                  alignment: right
                                  sizing: auto
                            title: ''
                            type: metric
                          grid:
                            h: 5
                            w: 12
                            x: 24
                            'y': 0
                          id: a1b2c3d4-0001-4000-8000-000000000002
                          type: vis
                        - config:
                            data_source:
                              index_pattern: kibana_sample_data_logs
                              time_field: timestamp
                              type: data_view_spec
                            ignore_global_filters: false
                            metrics:
                              - field: bytes
                                operation: average
                                type: primary
                            sampling: 1
                            styling:
                              primary:
                                labels:
                                  alignment: left
                                position: bottom
                                value:
                                  alignment: right
                                  sizing: auto
                            title: ''
                            type: metric
                          grid:
                            h: 5
                            w: 12
                            x: 36
                            'y': 0
                          id: a1b2c3d4-0001-4000-8000-000000000003
                          type: vis
                        - config:
                            axis:
                              x:
                                domain:
                                  rounding: false
                                  type: fit
                                grid:
                                  visible: true
                                labels:
                                  orientation: horizontal
                                scale: ordinal
                                ticks:
                                  visible: true
                                title:
                                  visible: false
                              'y':
                                anchor: start
                                domain:
                                  rounding: true
                                  type: full
                                grid:
                                  visible: true
                                labels:
                                  orientation: horizontal
                                scale: linear
                                ticks:
                                  visible: true
                                title:
                                  visible: true
                            layers:
                              - data_source:
                                  query: FROM kibana_sample_data_logs | STATS count = COUNT() BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
                                  type: esql
                                ignore_global_filters: false
                                sampling: 1
                                type: line
                                x:
                                  column: BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
                                'y':
                                  - axis_id: 'y'
                                    column: count
                            legend:
                              layout:
                                truncate:
                                  max_lines: 1
                                type: grid
                              placement: outside

content.text:
All four steps are done.

1. **Data view:** "Kibana Sample Data Flights" (index `kibana_sample_data_flights`) has 33 fields, including `Carrier`, `Cancelled` and `timestamp`. Its time field is `timestamp`.
2. **Dashboard:** "S4-c5e46a18 Flights" has two panels: "Flights over time" (a line chart of the count by `timestamp`) and the carrier panel (a bar chart of the count by `Carrier`, top 5 by default).
3. **Alert rule:** "S4-c5e46a18 Cancelled flights" is an Elasticsearch query rule on `kibana_sample_data_flights`. It runs every minute. It fires when the number of documents with `Cancelled: true` in the last 5 minutes is greater than 10. It was created enabled, so I didn't need to enable it afterwards. It has no actions attached, so it won't notify anyone when it fires.
4. **Panel edit and read-back:** I renamed the carrier panel to "Flights by carrier"; the update response shows the new title. Reading the rule back returned `enabled: true`.
